message.content: Telemetry confirms genuine failure on BAY-04 — I'll propose the approved replacement.

function.arguments: {"action_name":"replace_drive","justification":"Technician requested replacement with approval. Controller CRITICAL predictive failure with amber fault enabled (EV-LOG-SRV004-0013) and unrecovered Medium Error (EV-LOG-SRV004-0012). Solid amber LED (EV-IMG-SRV004_BAY04_AMBER_SOLID) per MAN-LED-01 denotes predictive failure requiring replacement; BAY-02 rebuild (EV-LOG-SRV004-0014) does not explain BAY-04.
